english.title: Use on a road a motor vehicle / trailer in such a condition it caused / was likely to cause danger
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[ motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[ trailer drawn by a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..),]_

(C)_[which was in such condition by reason of **(..SPECIFY THE DEFECT..)]_
(D)_[its **(..SPECIFY THE PART / ACCESSORY..) being in such condition by reason of **(..SPECIFY THE DEFECT..)]_

that danger was caused or was likely to be caused to any person in or on it or on a road
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 100(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
used on a road
a motor vehicle / trailer
defective part / accessory
caused / likely to be cause danger

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) OFFICERS SHOULD BE AWARE that this is a non-endorsable offence - a comparable endorsable offence exists under section 40A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 which should be used wherever possible.
(ii) See also offence wordings H3100, H3101 and H3107 - for using vehicle - danger of injury due the vehicle accessories/equipment, load/passengers or condition.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - One hundred pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level four on the legislative standard scale
